The advertisement for this app is the only professional thing I’ve seen as the person, or A.I that made it was very intelligent. The example that they use for the blur reducer or BlurBuster is simply a picture that they took from a non-blurry picture and made blurry just so that they could start that clip off by showing a blurry picture that they make not blurry with their blur buster or whatever it’s called in this app, which is not a very good app so far. I am working on a picture of my father who just recently passed away in January that was a Vietnam veteran as well as two years in Korea where he served in the army, and went to Afghanistan as a civilian contractor, trying to teach on Bagram Airfield how to work with sheet metal and it cannot help me look anywhere close to being as good as what their advertising by showing that picture of a blurry photo that they make not blurry because that’s just fake just like the colorized photos, obviously a modern day photos that was taken in color that they made black-and-white just so that they can start the clip showing a black-and-white photo that they make colored. This is a sales tactic of the snake oil kind… like hot pockets back in the 90s. They would melt them halfway and make a picture that looked really stuffed and dripping with really, really gooey cheese everywhere. In my so far honest opinion that is what this is… a bunch of cheese everywhere. However, if my review changes within the next week, or hour and I change this review the kudos and joy joy feelings, but until then all I’m seeing is an app made to take your money and just give you mediocre service.
